name: lddigest
description: Shared libc SP4: the machine binder's digest of dynsodyn's and dynsomisdyn's binding (LD_BIND_DIGEST: each patched site's word, each bank as library and segment, and the count) equals fgx_bind --digest's for the same libraries, and curssodyn's, taken through a first-use load of termlib and curses.  fgx_bind places the boot set, libc and /etc/ld.so.conf's libfgx, first, as the machine has them resident.  Control: a host digest made with no ld.so.conf (fgx_bind --conf of an empty file) puts curssodyn's termlib and curses 140 bytes higher, and `LDB same3' becomes `differ'.
